bioconda.name: disassembler
bioconda.summary: Reconstruct coding haplotypes of a target gene from planetary sequence indexes (Logan, kmindex, LexicMap).
bioconda.description:
Reconstructs in-frame coding haplotypes across many SRA runs from the Logan assemblies.
The kmindex route harvests candidate accessions from a kmindex query, stratifies them by
score and walks each accession's unitig graph with logan-walker. The LexicMap route tiles
LexicMap hits against Logan contigs into a codon-checked cohort. Both routes can thin
near-duplicates with kmer-diversity-sieve and end in a reference-guided codon alignment
(MAFFT) and a FastTree phylogeny.
